title: NM cable stripper, 12–14 AWG solid / 14–16 AWG stranded

sources.citation: Dual-slot strippers for non-metallic sheathed cable are a common class made by several makers (typical published figures, paraphrased, not one vendor's): slots that split the outer jacket of 12/2 and 14/2 cable, conductor holes for 12-14 AWG solid and 14-16 AWG stranded (each stranded marking two AWG numbers smaller than the solid one in the same hole, as on general strippers), and a cutting edge. Hole ids are stable save format.
